payload.name: Facial Anthropomorphism
payload.fact: Facial anthropomorphism in multimedia learning materials significantly improves transfer, retention, and comprehension.
payload.boundary: Applies to multimedia learning materials; effects are stronger for retention among juvenile students and static materials.

provenance.title: Effectiveness of facial anthropomorphism design for improving multimedia learning outcomes: systematic review and meta-analysis
provenance.quote_or_locus: For learning outcomes, facial anthropomorphism yielded significant improvements in transfer (standardized mean difference [SMD] 0.28, 95% CI 0.15 to 0.40, p < 0.001), retention (SMD 0.31, 95% CI 0.14 to 0.48, p < 0.001), and comprehension (SMD 0.46, 95% CI 0.27 to 0.64, p < 0.001
